notes.title: Mini City: Mayhem v1.1.0 - Bug Fixes & Balance
notes.content:
Hey Mayors! We have a first-week update where we fixed some bugs and improved the balance of the game.

Bug Fixes

Fixed Single Music Loop on Mods
   - Resolved an issue where certain mods would cause music to loop incorrectly. Now, music plays as intended across all mods.
Fixed Achievement13
   - Addressed a bug preventing Achievement13 from unlocking properly.
Fixed End Screen Issues
   - Resolved an issue where the pause/continue button was still interactable on the end screen.
   - Fixed a bug that caused the game to get stuck on the end screen.
Fixed Pointy End Lands Issue
   - Adjusted terrain generation to prevent sharp-ended land formations that required temporary block placements.
Added Temporary Bridge Blocks
   - Implemented temporary bridge blocks to fill in gaps caused by missing blocks, ensuring smoother gameplay.
Updated RunManager.cs
   - Internal code optimizations for improved performance and stability.


Balance Changes

Square Stack Minimum Time Nerf
   - Adjusted the minimum time for Square Stack timer to make it more balanced and less punishing.
Mayhem Mode Color Match Buff
   - Improved color-matching mechanics in Mayhem mode to enhance the pacing and fairness.
Level Threshold Balance Tweaks
   - Adjusted level progression thresholds to create a smoother difficulty curve.
Mod Balance and Tier Threshold Adjustments
   - Rebalanced mods and refined tier thresholds to ensure a more strategic and enjoyable experience.


If you have more bugs that need our attention, let us know on our Steam Community Forums or Join our Discord to report them to us directly.

Thank you for your support during our launch and the awesome reviews posted on our Steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/Mini_City_Mayhem/

notes.title: Mini City: Mayhem Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
The wait is over—Mini City: Mayhem is finally here! 🎉 Whether you're a speedrunner aiming for the perfect city under pressure or a laid-back builder who just wants to stack and chill, this game has something for you.

[previewyoutube=mgq9_ibstmE;full][/previewyoutube]

9 City Stages & Iconic Landmarks to Complete!

Your journey as mayor will take you through 9 unique city-building challenges, each with its own layout, obstacles, and iconic structures to complete. From tight spaces and towering builds to complex landscapes that demand strategic planning, every stage offers a fresh test of your skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/1c9e6271919ffb07d4ca3e47e82529a9f83c99b3.png

Game Modes

Whether you're a strategic mastermind aiming for efficiency or a cozy builder taking it slow, Mini City: Mayhem has a mode for you:


 🕹️ Mayhem Mode – A fast-paced challenge where every second counts.
 🌿 Zen Mode – A relaxing city-building experience, with no pressure.
 🏗️ Sandbox Mode – Unlimited creativity, no restrictions.
 🎯 Square Stack & Crane Modes – Unique puzzle challenges for a fresh spin on city-building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/9712d07f4917c411dcd0ebaaf72ae37cdc45680b.png

Steam Achievements

Mini City: Mayhem launches with 21 Steam Achievements for players to chase, ranging from mastering city-building skills to pulling off insane challenges! Whether you’re speed-running through Mayhem Mode, creating a perfectly balanced metropolis, or stacking your way to new heights, there’s an achievement waiting for you. 

We’ll be adding more achievements in future updates based on community feedback, new game modes, and exciting challenges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/e14f441f073525d97a0cfd775f82cecfcc950ff5.png

Get It Now!

Thank you for trying out the demo, giving feedback and helping us in developing the game. Get it now on  Steam with special 20% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/Mini_City_Mayhem/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Strategy Game Demos by Rogue Duck!
notes.content:
During the Steam Next Fest, we have 4 free game demos up for you to try out. If you played a game published by Rogue Duck Interactive before, you probably love replayable strategy games!

Let me start introducing our games, during the Next Fest, download the demos you are interested and become part of the development by giving us your valueable feedback.

New Next Fest Strategy Demos

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/Mini_City_Mayhem/

A city builder where you race against time to build your city! Become the mayor of a tiny town, plop down tiny building blocks to build a working city to progress.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179860/Pairs__Perils/

A memory-game roguelike and dungeon crawler. Match cards to attack enemies, avoid traps, shop for relics and consumables. Sharpen your mind as you journey through the depths of the dungeon in search of The Dealer.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056580/HEXAROMA_Village_Builder/

Build your charming medieval hexagon village in this city-builder. Strategize the best hexagon island placements. Place the building pieces strategically, and grow your village and your tiny island.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204250/Lost_But_Found/

A combination of a job simulator & hidden object game. In a top-down table, you are an officer who oversees the lost items in an airport. Organize those items and distribute them to people who lost their belongings. 

That's all we have for this Next Fest, we hope you found something you like. In that case, wishlist the games to stay in the loop!


Other Strategy Demos

Additionally, we have other demos, that's not participating in this edition of the Next Fest yet, but soon. Check them out too.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449450/Clonizer/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655590/Kingdoms_Deck/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945950/Dice_n_Goblins/

Have a strategy-filled Next Fest event, everyone! Follow us on our social media so you don't miss free strategy goodies!

notes.title: Mini City: Mayhem featured at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
To all my fellow mayors!

My name is Dora Özsoy, one of the lead Producers from Rogue Duck Interactive. While you probably know me for another city-building game called Cardboard Town, we’re incredibly excited to be bringing our next take on the genre called Mini City: Mayhem to this Fall edition of Steam Next Fest. A free demo is available to download right now, and don't forget to support us by wishlisting Mini City: Mayhem.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/

While Cardboard Town was more of a roguelite city builder, Mini City: Mayhem is different. We designed the latter more like a marriage of a cozy city builder with shape puzzle gameplay mechanics, and a rush against the clock aspect to it. But there’s more behind it than just that!

Beat the clock and become the city's longest running mayor!

It is your job as the freshly elected mayor of a town to turn a little plot of land into a bustling metropolis. Manage your resources, lay the foundation for important hubs for your expanding city, and watch as your populace grows. However, in Mini City: Mayhem, every second counts, so there's no time to relax and take pride in your work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/ae6316d21ae5917c5dc5abead1c6af3428dd7003.gif

A cozy city-builder that will puzzle you!

To make sure that your city grows and meets the needs of its residents, you'll need to act swiftly and wisely. In addition to strategically placing and stacking puzzle pieces depending on form to distribute vital structures like as residences, companies, and public services, roads must be thoughtfully designed to connect your buildings in an effective manner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/733bd12dc885912617364e25d06805c4f1df4c6e.gif

Different games modes for all types of urban planners.

Is the fast-paced city building not your thing? Then you'll be glad to know that we have something for all kinds of aspiring Mayors. Relax and play at your pace with Zen mode, or reduce the clock down speed with Patient mode, and more coming in the full release. Plus, Mini City: Mayhem features different starting maps inspired by outlines of iconic real and fantasy cities such as Pisa, Istanbul and New York, each with their most famous landmarks including the torre di Pisa, Galata Kulesi and the Statue of Liberty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45187924/34830db9ae5f0956a4d40fd8bcc8a7a9970f58bf.gif

So there we have it mayors, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about the game so far! We’ll be hard at work in the coming weeks to work on enhancing this game, while analyzing player’s reaction, feedback and more.
